message.content:
## Comparison

**1) Running header**
- LEFT: single centered section title ("כיצד מציתין...") only.
- RIGHT: same centered title, but additionally shows the tractate name "ברכות" on both outer edges of the header.
- → DIFFERENCE: NEW engine adds flanking header text the OLD engine does not have.

**2) Column layout**
- Both sides use a two-column RTL body layout with the same block structure (main text, Mishnah/Talmud bold segments, marginal notes in the inner/outer margins).
- Marginal note placement and the bottom commentary block (light gray) appear in equivalent positions.

**3) Line spacing**
- LEFT: looser, airier leading; columns fill the full depth of the page down to the gray commentary block.
- RIGHT: noticeably tighter vertical pitch — the whole body block is compressed into roughly the upper half of the text area. Interline spacing is not the same as reference.

**4) Window words**
- LEFT: columns fill evenly; no significant window.
- RIGHT: the left (second) column terminates early, leaving a large blank window at the bottom of the text area before the commentary block. Clear window-word / column-break mismatch.

**5) Overall parity**
- Content, bold catches (ויהיו etc.), and footnote/margin structure match.
- Folio/catchword at page bottom: LEFT shows catchword "הכת"; RIGHT shows folio "עו". Different bottom-of-page elements.

## Verdict: DIFFERENCES

1. Header: NEW adds flanking "ברכות" not present in OLD.
2. Line spacing: NEW is significantly tighter than reference.
3. Window words: NEW left column ends early, leaving a large window; OLD columns are full/balanced.
4. Bottom element: catchword (OLD) vs. folio number (NEW) mismatch.
message.reasoning_content: Compare: left has two columns, right also two columns. Right header shows center title plus "ברכות" on sides; left shows only center title, no folio numbers visible. Right has page number "עו" at bottom, left has "הכת" (catchword?) — left bottom shows catchword הכת; right bottom shows עו page number. Right column heights: left column ends earlier? Right page: right column ends higher (window words at bottom of one column?). Actually in RTL, right column fills first, then left. On right image, text ends mid-left column with whitespace — window words. Left image columns appear balanced ending at same height. Line spacing: right lines appear tighter/more compressed? Left columns end evenly; right has window at bottom of left column.
